name: Call another rule
description: Runs a different rule and uses its result. Useful for breaking a big problem into reusable smaller rules — e.g. a façade rule that fans out to many small ones.

inputs.name: payload
inputs.description: Optional object to pass through as the sub-rule's request when no input mapping is given.

params.name: ruleId
params.description: ID of the rule to invoke.

params.name: pinnedVersion
params.description: Optional version pin. Latest published if omitted.

params.name: inputMapping
params.description: Map the sub-rule's input fields → where each value comes from in this rule (a path like $.x).

params.name: outputMapping
params.description: Map fields from the sub-rule's result → fields on this rule's record.

params.name: onError
params.description: What to do if the sub-rule errors or returns nothing.

enum.label: Fail
enum.description: Propagate the error and fail this rule.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Skip the sub-rule's effect and carry on.

enum.label: Use default
enum.description: Use the configured default value instead.
